x_failures: Says the Orphic 'figur'd seal' was the winds stamping forms on the world, but on Taylor p.184 the seal belongs to Apollo/Pan; lists 'Libonotus (SSW)' and 'Favonius' for Chilam Balam p.128, which gives Notus and Zephyrus; cites Agrippa p.37 for the Homeric four-wind scheme, but that page never mentions Homer.
y_failures: Minor: Comenius p.768 does not clearly support Favonius being 'flanked by Africus and Corus' (that pairing comes from Isidore).
reason: Y's quotations from Pliny, Seneca/Varro, Vitruvius, Isidore, Honterus and Avicenna are all on the cited pages, and it traces the four-, twelve- and eight-wind schemes and how readings of them changed. X misreads the Orphic page and changes wind names on the Chilam Balam page.
